name: seo-ai-visibility-check
summary: Run bounded, explicitly scoped AI/search visibility observations with source, approval, and reproducibility labels.
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live AI/search/provider/page reads and record approval
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: provider, content, schema, CMS, code, analytics, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: engine/model/provider, market, prompts, date, scope, approval, and limits are explicit
observations include output, mentions/citations, URLs, timestamp, and reproducibility where permitted
no output, citation, mention, referral, source, timestamp, or visibility result is fabricated
universal, stable, causal, or future visibility claims are absent
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated AI observations
verify no provider, content, schema, CMS, code, analytics, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
